provider.transport: internal/productnative with explicit --auth-source native for the complete operation
provider.hidden_ga: 17.6 removes ci_hidden_variables feature flag; hidden is a UI-reveal restriction, not API non-disclosure
provider.hidden_transition: create only; no update from unhidden to hidden

surface.credential_binding: openNative once after syntax/private-input validation; same configured authority and native credential for every preflight, inventory, mutation and reconciliation
surface.list: exact scope, metadata only, no values or descriptions in either family
surface.secret_set: create hidden+masked or rotate existing hidden; preserve existing type and protected flag
surface.variable_set: create or update ordinary unmasked, unhidden, unprotected entries only
surface.platforms: mutations unavailable on Windows until private-file DACL verification exists; Windows persisted-native-config and self-managed mapping remain unproven even for metadata reads
surface.delete: explicit confirm, exact private previous value and class/type/protected/raw guards
surface.existing_value_guard: private expected-value file, no exported hash
surface.input: explicit value-file absolute private regular file or '-' for bounded piped stdin; exact UTF-8 bytes, no NUL or newline trimming
surface.absence_evidence: complete successful list, never 404 or a provider error
surface.receipt: postcondition_observed, never claimed provider CAS or exclusive write attribution

parity_differences: ordinary variable values are deliberately not displayed, unlike gh-axi variable list
no argv value channel even for ordinary variables
GitLab hidden/masked/protected controls are distinct and not GitHub encrypted-secret storage
caller must already possess the old value to update or delete; no credential extraction path
no implicit upsert, class/type/protection transition, group/instance scope, inherited inventory, or bulk dotenv import
older servers and missing hidden metadata fail closed; no fallback to masked-unhidden secrets
native and official profiles may be different accounts; no automatic selection or fallback
the shared native boundary refuses selected authentication credential material in request bodies or provider responses
